title: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Bistable Images

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing vision-language models' initial interpretations of bistable optical illusions (e.g., Duck-Rabbit, Rubin Vase) against human subject preferences to evaluate alignment with human visual and cognitive biases.

Substituting image classification labels with synonyms of varying commonality (e.g., 'beggar' vs. 'panhandler') to measure the influence of underlying language model training frequencies on the model's visual interpretations.
